question: What is the time complexity of searching in a balanced binary search tree?
What is the difference between a stack and a queue?
expected_answer: A stack follows LIFO (last in, first out) and only needs one pointer (top). A queue follows FIFO (first in, first out) and needs two pointers (front and rear).
